title: Double Advanced Math Program
body:
Ten weeks of weekend math
Models, reasoning, and daily practice

title: How a session runs
body:
Recall earlier math.
Try a problem before seeing a method.
Use a model, then compare ideas.
Explain the idea in your own words.
Finish with one independent problem.

title: A claim to check
